messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming.handshake.error_rate > 3% (5m) in eu-west-1 for rollout sdk/v5.4 — linked: https://grafana.example/reports/alert/3815554321

alice-m: seeing a spike in 500s from paging/stream endpoints since ~09:12 UTC. Looks like most failures are handshake errors. Affected customers: acme-inc (dedicated), beta-saas (hosted).

ben-oncall: acked. I'm on it, moving to incident channel. Can we get the rollout id and which clusters?

deploy-bot: Rollout sdk/v5.4 (id: r-20260315-9f2a) — canary eu-west-1 at 42% — started 09:05 UTC — affected clusters: inference-eu-west-1-a/b

alice-m: error sample from logs: ```ERROR handshake: unexpected frame type=0x7 from client sdk/5.4 commit=9f2a
stack: rpc/stream/negotiation.go:142
cause: unknown field 'slot'```

-- dave-eng joined the thread --

dave-eng: quick context — SDK v5.4 added optional streaming header negotiation to support "slot" metadata (see PR #4721). Older router code rejects unknown frame types. I think the new header is being encoded as a new frame type.

eve-cs: customer acme-inc just opened a P1 case: CASE-4127. Their production workflows are failing to paginate large chat histories. They report timeouts and partial streams. Impact: major tenant-facing features degraded.

carla-pm: ok we need an immediate mitigation: either rollback rollout or kill the negotiation feature flag. Which is faster?

ben-oncall: killing the FF is faster. I can flip it. Need FF key.

-- carla-pm shared internal runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/incident/runbooks/streaming-negotiation --

-- ben-oncall executed: --
ben-oncall: running toggle now: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' \
  https://flags.redwood/api/toggles/streaming_new_negotiation/disable \
  -d '{"env":"eu-west-1","actor":"ben-oncall","reason":"emergency mitigation - rolling back negotiation"}'```

ben-oncall: response: {"status":"ok","toggle":"streaming_new_negotiation","state":"disabled","id":"ff-88a2"} — feature flag successfully disabled at 09:22:34 UTC

incident-bot: NOTE: feature flag streaming_new_negotiation disabled — automatic rollback to legacy handshake enabled for all canaries in eu-west-1

dave-eng: monitoring shows handshake error rate dropped from 3.4% -> 0.6% within 3m after FF flip. Looks like killing FF mitigated. Still need a durable fix.

alice-m: collecting metrics for customer impact: acme-inc saw 72 failed streams in 09:05-09:25 window (est. 4% of their traffic), beta-saas ~210 failures (6% traffic). Recording for post-incident SLA assessment.

carla-pm: decision: keep FF disabled, pause further rollout, and release a hotpatch to SDK and router so v5.4 can gracefully accept unknown frames. Also prepare rollback plan if needed.

-- dave-eng posted a quick patch idea: --
dave-eng: proposal (short-term): accept unknown frame types in router and treat unknown 'slot' metadata as opaque (no-fail). Patch gist: https://github.com/redwood/infra/patches/pp-5792 — PR ready: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5793 (hotpatch -> canary 10% then ramp).

-- ben-oncall: I'm initiating on-call handoff to fiona-oncall for overnight monitoring. Leaving notes. --
ben-oncall: handoff summary: mitigation executed (FF disabled), error rate back to baseline, affected customers logged (CASE-4127, CASE-4129), hotpatch PR #5793 in flight, next actions: run more integration tests, coordinate limited canary of hotpatch, prepare customer comms.

fiona-oncall: taking over. I'll watch the graphs until 03:00 UTC and coordinate with dave for the canary. Please DM any urgent updates.

eve-cs: prepping customer comms template. Draft snippet: "We detected degraded streaming responses after a recent SDK rollout. We've disabled the new negotiation feature and restored normal service. We are issuing a follow-up with root cause and remediation timeline. Case ID: CASE-4127." Can we confirm timeline for hotpatch canary?

carla-pm: target hotpatch canary in 60m after extra smoke tests. If green, roll to 25% by +3h. If any regressions, we will rollback hotpatch and keep FF disabled.

dave-eng: quick note: root cause short version — SDK introduced a new optional frame type for header negotiation; routers were strict and error'd on unknown frames. Long term we should make router negotiation backward-compatible and add a validation matrix in release process.

alice-m: logging reminders: correlate stream failures to SDK user-agent and rollout ids. I'll export logs and attach to postmortem.

fiona-oncall: acknowledged. I've added myself to the incident doc and set a check-in at 10:30 UTC. Leaving channel open for updates.

carla-pm: assign postmortem: lead = dave-eng, reviewer = alice-m, timeline owner = ben-oncall. Expect draft in 72h. Also flag for release process improvements (add proto-negotiation gating).

eve-cs: I'll send the customer update now referencing the mitigation and offering a follow-up call.

-- end of thread summary: mitigation=FF disabled, immediate impact reduced, next steps=hotpatch PR #5793 canary -> ramp, postmortem planned. --
